steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a secondary degree plus relevant work hours, or a bachelor's degree with fewer required hours. Verify your background meets PMI standards before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Sumter-based professionals attend scheduled sessions from your location, gaining comprehensive knowledge of project-management frameworks, processes, and best practices aligned to PMI's Body of Knowledge.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your formal application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy supports you through this process, clarifying requirements specific to your background and role.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor guidance. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. Our team remains available to address final questions before you sit for the computer-based assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional-development units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year certification cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources to support ongoing PMP renewal and career advancement in Sumter's growing project-management field.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
